integrity_note: A self-contained proof and a standalone finite-field checker are included. Finite exhaustions support but do not certify the infinite statement; bibliographic originality beyond inspected sources is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labelled invertible natural-basis structure matrices only; not uniform isomorphism classes. General odd-characteristic distribution and higher moments remain open. Semilinear theory may imply the even-characteristic corollary; no independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_statement: Let \(q\) be a prime power, \(n\ge2\), and \(M\) uniformly distributed over \(\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb F_q)\). For the perfect evolution algebra with \(e_i^2=\sum_j M_{ji}e_j\), write \(X(M)\) for its number of nonzero idempotents over \(\mathbb F_q\). Then \(\mathbb E X=1\), and \(\operatorname{Var}X=1\) in characteristic two, whereas for odd \(q\) it equals \(1-\frac{(q-1)((2q-1)^n-2q^n+1)}{2(q^n-1)(q^n-q)}\). In characteristic two, the complete law is field-size independent: \(X=2^R-1\), where \(\Pr(R=r)=\sum_{k=r}^n(-1)^{k-r}2^{\binom{k-r}{2}}\left[\begin{smallmatrix}k\\r\end{smallmatrix}\right]_2/|\mathrm{GL}_k(\mathbb F_2)|\) for \(0\le r\le n\), with the usual Gaussian binomial convention and \(|\mathrm{GL}_0|=1\).
title: Idempotent fluctuations of uniformly sampled perfect evolution algebras over finite fields
